app_user_clinic_regno_uq.name: app_user_clinic_regno_uq
app_user_clinic_regno_uq.where: medical_registration_number IS NOT NULL AND is_active = true

patient_clinic_active_idx.name: patient_clinic_active_idx
patient_clinic_active_idx.where: is_active = true AND merged_into_patient_id IS NULL

allergy_clinic_molecule_idx.name: allergy_clinic_molecule_idx
allergy_clinic_molecule_idx.where: substance_molecule_id IS NOT NULL AND refuted_at IS NULL

lab_order_awaiting_idx.name: lab_order_awaiting_idx
lab_order_awaiting_idx.where: status IN ('ORDERED', 'RESULTED') AND reviewed_at IS NULL

lab_result_has_a_value.name: lab_result_has_a_value
lab_result_has_a_value.value: value_numeric IS NOT NULL OR coalesce(trim(value_text), '') <> ''

scheduled_reminder_encounter_uq.name: scheduled_reminder_encounter_uq
scheduled_reminder_encounter_uq.where: encounter_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING', 'SENT')

schedule_exception_ends_after_start.name: schedule_exception_ends_after_start
schedule_exception_ends_after_start.value: starts_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at
